blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines – The Toledo Xignex Trojans scored back-to-back victories in contrasting fashions in the ongoing “Wesley So Cup” of the Professional Chess Association of the Philippines (PCAP) on Thursday, November 12. The Trojans edged the Quezon City Chessmates Stallions, 12-9, before clobbering the Zamboanga Sultans to strengthen their hold on the No. 2 spot in the Omega Division. Toledo improved to 21 wins and four losses, just one victory behind division leader Sudeco-Manila Indios Bravos, which holds a 22-3 win-loss record.
